links.outcome: Urgency recognition and red flag identification scores of LLMs on ophthalmic emergency vignettes
links.effect: Overall scores 6.88 (ChatGPT), 7.03 (Gemini), 6.93 (Claude) of 8; no significant differences in urgency triage or red flag recognition; diagnostic errors and suboptimal management noted.
links.quote: Additional comparison across diagnostic scores, urgency triage, red flag recognition, and management scores yielded no significant differences between any of the LLMs.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance of three commercial LLMs on 40 standardized clinical vignettes for ophthalmic emergency triage and management, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
